messages:
maya: Heads-up — we can't find KMS Decrypt CloudTrail events for a subset of envelope decrypts on prod S3 objects after last week's RBAC changes. GenerateDataKey shows up but subsequent access doesn't show Decrypt at all. Anyone seen this? :thinking:

liam: Can you paste a minimal CloudTrail snippet + an object key example? region? role used?

maya: region: us-west-2
object: s3://redwood-prod-attachments/2026/03/19/obj-xyz
CloudTrail search:
```
{ "eventName": "GenerateDataKey", "eventTime": "2026-03-19T09:12:03Z", "userIdentity": {"arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/service-role/lambda-A"} }
```
But no matching `Decrypt` events around the access time (09:12:04–09:20:00). We see app logs showing successful local decrypt and AES decrypt of envelope.

ops-jen: Did we enable client-side data key caching anywhere? We rolled out a caching config for the AWS Encryption SDK last week to reduce KMS QPS.

maya: Yes — ops changed the Java Encryption SDK CMM to use caching with MaxCacheEntries=1000 and EntryTTL=24h on Mar 18.

anil: That explains it — the AWS Encryption SDK's caching CMM will fetch a data key from KMS once (GenerateDataKey) and cache the plaintext data key. Subsequent decrypts use the cached key locally and don't call KMS, so CloudTrail doesn't record Decrypt for each access. Only the initial GenerateDataKey shows up.

liam: Ohhh. So missing Decrypt events doesn't mean unauthorised access — it can be legitimate local decrypts.

maya: Compliance requires per-access KMS audit for these PII blobs. We need options.

anil: Options:
- disable client-side caching for keys that require per-access audit
- reduce EntryTTL to something acceptable (e.g., 5m) to increase KMS calls
- log an audit entry in the application for every decrypt (include envelope metadata + caller identity)
- use a KMS-backed symmetric key with an enforcement layer that forces KMS Decrypt (but not trivial)

ops-jen: Also consider rotating data keys more often so GenerateDataKey events are more frequent if that helps blanket audits.

maya: For immediate mitigation I disabled caching in the staging CMM and will push to prod in a canary.

security-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-89 for "Audit: ensure per-access KMS visibility for PII" (linked: https://tracker.internal/SEC-2026-89)

liam: Nice. Also add an annotation in CloudTrail query dashboard to show GenerateDataKey + app logs correlation.

maya: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ops-jen: follow-up — we should add a note to the KMS runbook about caching & audit tradeoffs.

anil: Agreed — I'll draft a short doc and paste in #docs-security.

maya: Closing out here, moving PR to disable cache for flagged keys.
